Old Timey Mono

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Wafting zephyrs quickly vex bold Jim. Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs. The five boxing wizards jump quickly. Amazingly few discotheques provide jukeboxes. Fat wealthy diva became rocking jazz saxophone queen. How vexingly quick daft zebras jump! Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow. Heavy boxes perform quick waltzes and jigs. Cwm fjord bank glyphs vext quiz. Carved symbols in a mountain hollow on the bank of an inlet irritated an eccentric person.

Old Timey Code

/**
 * If it’s good enough for reproductions...
 * ...it’s good enough for code.
 */
float Q_rsqrt(float number) {
     long i;
     float x2, y;
     x2 = number * 0.5F;
     y = number;
     i = * (long *) &y;
     i = 0x5f3759df - (i >> 1);   /* what the heck? */
     y = * (float *) &i;
     y = y * (1.5F - (x2 * y * y));
}
